name: Kathleen Lonsdale
summary: English crystallographer known for proving the planar structure of benzene and leadership in international crystallography.

name: Thomas Lonsdale
summary: Physicist and husband of Kathleen Lonsdale.

name: W. H. Bragg
summary: Physicist who led the research team Kathleen Lonsdale joined at University College London and the Royal Institution.

name: W. T. Astbury
summary: Crystallographer who collaborated with Kathleen Lonsdale on space group tables.

name: Dorothy Hodgkin
summary: Crystallographer who prepared the Royal Society Obituary Notice for Kathleen Lonsdale.

name: H. Judith Milledge
summary: Crystallographer and author of this obituary.

name: Bedford College for Women
summary: Women's college of the University of London where Kathleen Lonsdale studied physics.

name: University College London
summary: University where Kathleen Lonsdale served as Professor of Chemistry and Head of Crystallography.

name: Royal Institution
summary: London research institution where Kathleen Lonsdale worked under W. H. Bragg.

name: University of Leeds
summary: University where Kathleen Lonsdale worked for two years after her marriage.

name: Royal Society
summary: Scientific academy that elected Kathleen Lonsdale as a Fellow and awarded her the Davy Medal.

name: Holloway Gaol
summary: Prison where Kathleen Lonsdale spent a month in 1943.

name: International Union of Crystallography
summary: International organization where Kathleen Lonsdale served as Vice-President.

name: British Association for the Advancement of Science
summary: Scientific organization where Kathleen Lonsdale served as General Secretary and later President.

name: Society of Friends
summary: Religious group Kathleen Lonsdale joined in 1935.

name: National Institutes of Health
summary: Research institution in Bethesda where Kathleen Lonsdale was a special research fellow.

name: Newbridge, County Kildare
summary: Town in County Kildare, Ireland, where Kathleen Lonsdale was born.

name: Tables for the Determination of Space Groups
summary: Reference work on crystallographic space groups co-authored by Kathleen Lonsdale and W. T. Astbury.

name: Crystals and X-rays
summary: Book based on university extension lectures written by Kathleen Lonsdale.

name: Is Peace Possible?
summary: Book written by Kathleen Lonsdale on technological considerations in international disputes.

name: International Tables for X-ray Crystallography
summary: Multi-volume reference work for which Kathleen Lonsdale had overall responsibility for the first three volumes.

name: Davy Medal
summary: Award from the Royal Society given to Kathleen Lonsdale in 1957.

name: lonsdaleite
summary: Wurtzite form of carbon named after Kathleen Lonsdale.
